investigations.name: tnf-fate-in-space
investigations.title: TNF fate in space
investigations.description: What decides whether a cell survives or dies when TNF reaches it by diffusion, and does space act only through the dose that arrives, or also through when it arrives?
investigations.question: What decides whether a cell survives or dies when TNF reaches it by diffusion, and does space act only through the dose that arrives, or also through when it arrives?
investigations.hypothesis: Map each run with a diffusing TNF bolus onto the uniform-dose curve by the TNF dose that reached the cell (peak and time-integrated). If fate collapses onto that curve, space acts only through dose; if it does not, arrival timing matters. NF-kB's nuclear wave timing under the moving front is the mechanism either way. Every coupling is first calibrated (Study 0) on parts verified by the workspace's compose-api checks.
